# unifi_media_file (Data Source)

The `unifi_media_file` data source retrieves an existing media file by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing media file by name.
data "unifi_media_file" "intro" {
  name = "intro.mp4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the media file to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
